t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Different gnomes lead to different forests, gnome size, hat colour and shape are relevant to the amount of mushrooms each gnome leads to.

vb_textbox.text: In all honesty, I went for the short green hatted, short orange hatted and blue hatted gnomes and I think I did reasonably well. my best advice to you is not to get too zoned out with how repetitive the task is and miss out on points
